method: Per-variable areas from the noise-free generator rasters of the first and last year.
rules: Glacier tongues end at elevations that rise at a different rate for each of four basins (2.0 to 13.0 m per year).
Snow cover follows a snowline that varies randomly from year to year, with no trend.
A proglacial lake grows in the area vacated by one glacier after 2009.
Terrain elevation is identical in every year.
